details.report: Closed exact keys NavigatorReceiptContract, AssistedInputContractClosure, and SchemaContractParity. Recovery invocationId now rejects before run-index/filesystem access; malformed recovery proves no filesystem, ledger, acquisition, or spawn side effects. Recorded refused-defect receipts now require the defect evidenceId in top-level citations and a fully-read receipt record, so extraction/recovery fail closed. Schema parity now packs an isolated source tree, cold-installs the tarball into a new consumer, imports package runtime exports, and checks deep/cross-variant matrices without touching shared dist. Gates passed: git diff --check; npm run typecheck; npm test (435 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped); npm run build:recorder; npm pack --dry-run. Commit 32320f343afc997cf18acfc9e3396d63df6b4c42.
